crew.overview: In 1933 New York, an overly ambitious movie producer coerces his cast and hired ship crew to travel to mysterious Skull Island, where they encounter Kong, a giant ape who is immediately smitten with the leading lady.
crew.title: King Kong

crew.overview: Struggling to find his place in the world while juggling school and family, Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is unexpectedly bitten by a radioactive spider and develops unfathomable powers just like the one and only Spider-Man. While wrestling with the implications of his new abilities, Miles discovers a super collider created by the madman Wilson "Kingpin" Fisk, causing others from across the Spider-Verse to be inadvertently transported to his dimension.
crew.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

crew.overview: When K-pop superstars Rumi, Mira and Zoey aren't selling out stadiums, they're using their secret powers to protect their fans from supernatural threats.
crew.title: KPop Demon Hunters

details.biography:
Atsushi Sato (佐藤 篤司) is a Japanese animator currently working for Sony Pictures Imageworks in Vancouver. Previously, he worked for Walt Disney Feature Animation.

Atsushi Sato was born in 1964. After graduating from Tama Art Junior College, he moved to the United States in 1991. As a senior animator, he has participated in Lord of the Rings: Two Towers and Lord of the Rings: Return of the King, as well as an animator supervisor in King Kong (2005) and I, Robot, as a character animator in Alice in Wonderland (2010), and as a senior character animator in The Amazing Spider-Man.
details.name: Atsushi Sato
